posts.title: Will Barack Obama ever run out of race cards?
posts.description: Op-ed views and opinions expressed are solely those of the author. How many times must we witness the first black president, Barack Obama, whip out the race card? This is the latest. While speaking at a forum to welcome the incoming freshman House Democrats, Obama said: “One of the things that always struck me each time I did it — and I did eight of them — you go into the House chamber for the State of the Union, and on one side, everybody looked the same. “I mean, it’s like a golf country club on one side, and then you got, on the Democratic side, you just had America.” The audience laughed. Was Obama saying that because most House Republicans are white — even worse, are mostly white men — it is a result of intentional exclusion by the GOP? Was he saying white Republican House members, because of their race and gender, are, by definition, not “America”? ‘Good luck!’ DHS blasts California’s sanctuary policies after local cops abandon surrounded ICE agents
posts.description: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) blasted California officials after bodycam video showed local law enforcement leaving immigration enforcement agents at the mercy of an angry mob. In the video of the Oct. 17 incident that went down in Long Beach, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers are in the process of conducting an arrest of a criminal illegal alien from Mexico whose rap sheet included felony domestic violence and who local cops had previously refused to hold on a detainer from ICE. “During the arrest, rioters blocked exits with cars and trash cans to trap federal vehicles, while ICE officers arrested two people for damaging government vehicles before one escaped when another rioter yanked open the door of the vehicle holding her,” according to Fox News. “We’re being ordered to pull out.
